name: Ogemray Smart relay 25A
summary: Powered-by-Shelly 25A/6kW single-channel metering relay with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, scripting and KNXnet/IP.

extra.mounting: compact enclosure with wall anchors + bracket (not a DIN or in-box Shelly form)
extra.wiring_note: wiring legend lists a COM terminal; dry vs wet contact not stated

gotchas: Terminals take 14-9 AWG (2.5-6 mm²) only — thin 18/20 AWG switch-leg wire needs ferrules/pigtails
Protection is overvoltage/overpower only — no overtemperature protection listed
No UL listing stated in specs; third-party (Ogemray) hardware on Shelly firmware
Not DIN-rail — for panel installs with LAN use Shelly Pro 1 (16A, no metering)
best_for: water heaters, EVSE-adjacent or other 20-25A resistive loads where you also want kWh
